Thieves in PPE kits steal jewelry and cash from Ratlam shop

Three thieves, wearing PPE kits, entered a shop in Ratlam and stole jewelry and cash worth ₹2 lakh. In a twist, the thieves were reportedly deceived by a shop board, stealing artificial jewelry instead of real items.
